text: Lwazi - knee op @ St Thomas's 2 November 2026. mum staying w/ him for the wk after. text him the night before. he's v nervous, last op went badly & he was in for 2 wks w/ an infection. also his gf Ayo wants to do a rota of meals - I'm down for the Weds. ask her what he can actually eat after
Ming & Abebe engaged!! proposal in Lisbon, wedding prob summer 2027. she's already stressing re venue
Reggie back home after 4 nights in hosp. gallbladder out. sore but ok. his wife Jasmine run ragged w/ the kids
dentist Thurs 9.40. pick up prescription on way back

Alice - 10th anniv w/ Rory end of the month. thinking Paris, not booked yet. she hinted she wants a proper camera. Rory clueless as usual, asked me for ideas. told him Fujifilm, something small. also their 1st date was @ that Italian place in Soho that's closing - maybe a dinner there before it shuts

Siddharth's dad - hip replacement sometime next week, date tbc. Sid v anxious, keeps checking his phone. check in w/ him Fri. his mum not coping well either, she can't drive & the hosp is 40 mins away. Sid's brother Anil in Canada, can't get back. Sid basically doing it all alone on top of work
Fang & Elijah wedding 14 March 2027 @ Kew. save the date came today. need to book hotel before prices go up
Alessia - scan results back, all clear. huge relief. she's off to Sardinia w/ her sister Nia early March to celebrate
Tendai = Tee. allergic to nuts, v serious. bear in mind for xmas dinner

rang Anil re his mum. she had a fall Sun, broken wrist, in plaster 6 wks. he's driving up every wkend. offer to cover his Sat shift. his mum refusing to have carers in, v stubborn. he's knackered, said the drive is 3 hrs each way. his sister Lin lives closer but just had twins so no help there
Ignacio's sister Marisol getting married in Seville June 2027. he's best man & terrified of the speech
Nasser - colonoscopy Tues. nervous, hates needles. ask how it went Wed
Lin & Ahmed - 25th wedding anniv 3 Dec. kids throwing surprise do @ the Crown. don't mention to Lin!!
Tomás has a new rescue greyhound, Pepper. v shy, hides under table. he's besotted
wedding off - Niamh & Bilal split end of Aug. she's moved back to her parents in Cork. message her sometime next week, low key
Chris - cataract surgery left eye 18 Nov, right eye early Jan. can't drive for a bit. I'm taking him to the first one

Yosef + Deepa: baby due end of Feb. Deepa had awful morning sickness but better now. Yosef's mum moving in over the summer to help. they're still mid-renovation on the kitchen, which Deepa is NOT happy about. Yosef swears it'll be done by Xmas. hospital tour @ the Whittington 12 Jan. they want a water birth if poss. Yosef wants to know if I still have the cot
Liam's grandad passed Fri. funeral sometime next wk. send card
Jess - physio 2x a wk post ACL recon. says it's slow going, down about missing the season. she likes those Ottolenghi books - gift?
Ayo got engaged to his gf Sana last wkend!! ring was his gran's. party 21 Nov @ theirs. bring fizz

Chloe @ work - her husband in for heart bypass 30 Oct. she's taking 2 wks off. cover her Mon meeting. ask Reggie to sign card. surgery's been put off twice already so she's on edge. their son Liam doing his A levels this year too, so v bad timing. she said they'll know more about recovery after the first wk
Uncle Tendai's 40th wedding anniv - big lunch Sun 8 Nov. Mum wants me to do a slideshow. dig out old photos
Lwazi out of hosp. op went well, on crutches 6 wks. bored stiff. watching all of Succession
Ming says Abebe's brother Elijah has to have his tonsils out @ 30 lol. sometime in Jan
Alessia nervous re driving test 12 Dec, 3rd attempt. text her good luck the morning of
Fang - vegan now, also no mushrooms. hates surprise parties
Siddharth update: dad's hip op moved to 4 Nov. Sid flying in from Dubai 2 Nov, back 15th. I should offer him a lift from Heathrow
Nia and her partner Jasmine - civil partnership 22 May 2027 in Brighton. small, 40 ppl. we're invited
call GP re results. also book flu jab before end of the month
Anil - promotion confirmed, head of ops from Jan. celebrating Fri w/ team. congratulate him properly when I see him
Ignacio's wife Alice in for gallstone op Thurs, day surgery. kids at his mum's. he's fine, she's a bit on edge
Nasser - results fine, no polyps. back at work Mon
Marisol's dog Biscuit had op on his leg last wk, cone of shame. she's been sleeping on the sofa w/ him
Lin: retirement do for Ahmed 15 Jan 2027. teaching 32 yrs. he wants a greenhouse - group gift? ask Chris & Jess if they'll chip in
Tomás + Rory 5 yr anniv yesterday. went to the Ledbury. Rory proposed!! wedding over the summer, prob Mallorca

Niamh doing ok-ish. new job in Cork starts 1 Dec, admin @ UCC. ring her the wk after to see how it's going. she said the breakup was mutual but she sounded flat. Bilal kept the flat. her mum's thrilled to have her home, keeps feeding her. she's thinking about getting a dog once settled - wants a spaniel
Bilal - hospital appt re his back sometime next week. waiting on MRI since Aug. struggling, can't sit at desk long. he's an architect, works from home now
Chris' daughter Chloe graduating from Leeds 9 Dec. he's so proud. card + something small
Deepa = Dee. Yosef calls her Dee-Dee lol. she's a midwife @ the Royal Free, funny given everything
Liam - mum's funeral went ok. he's taking a wk off, then back at it. pop round with food Thurs
Jess & Ayo met at climbing. she's the stronger one apparently. both v into bouldering
Sana - Ayo's fiancée - is a GP in Croydon. wedding maybe spring 2027, early April. she wants something small; his family want 300 ppl
rang Mrs Kowalski re the flat. boiler fixed Weds. rent going up from 1 Jan 2027
Reggie's wife Jasmine had her stitches out today. walking better. Reggie back at work end of the month
Lwazi Patel, aka Lwaz - follow-up appt w/ consultant 7 Dec. hoping to drop crutches by xmas. remind him to book physio

Elijah's mum Mrs Williams - 70th bday 12 Nov. he's organising a meal & dreading it. his sister Fang no help. maybe offer to help w/ the booking. she's v fussy, gluten free, hates loud places. he's thinking the Ivy in Richmond or somewhere near Kew. she loves gardening & old jazz - wd love a Kew membership apparently
Abebe - starting new job @ Arup 16 Nov. leaving drinks Fri wk. Ming says he's buzzing
mot due early March. sort car insurance renewal too
Ming - her gran in hospice now. family taking turns. Ming there most evenings. checked in today, she's exhausted but holding up. text her Sun
Dr Nakamura (Siddharth's dad's surgeon) says recovery 6-8 wks. Sid thinking of staying longer, maybe till early Dec. his boss ok w/ remote
Alice & Rory anniversary trip booked - Paris 27-30 Nov. she asked me to feed their cat Mochi. pick up keys from her Weds
Chloe Morris - Chlo - 30th 6 Feb, party in Bristol. Jess going too, car share?
Anil's wife Deepa had baby girl Sat!! Aria, 7lb 2. both doing well. send flowers, maybe drop round in a couple wks
Ignacio: Alice home, op fine. he's cooking for once lol. she's off work till 10 Nov
Tomás' mum - knee op sometime over the summer, waiting list. he's worried she'll leave it too long. she still does 10k steps a day
Rory proposal: Tomás said yes. engagement party early Jan, prob @ Rory's parents' in Bath. Rory's brother Nasser doing the music

Ayo's dad - pacemaker fitted Mon. went smoothly, home Weds. Ayo flying to Lagos 3 Nov for 2 wks to help. check in w/ him while he's there. also water his plants - spare key w/ Sana. his dad's always been fit, ran marathons into his 60s, so it was a shock. Ayo's mum doing ok but tired. Ayo was meant to be at the stag in Prague 7 Nov but now can't go
sort photos for Lin's anniversary thing by end of next wk. order album online

Bilal: MRI showed slipped disc. surgery maybe March 2027 if physio doesn't work. Niamh asked after him, they're still mates. he's into vinyl - new turntable would go down well. lunch w/ him sometime next week, my treat

Yosef - first anniv 4 Nov. Deepa hasn't a clue he's planned a weekend in the Cotswolds. he's nervous about the drive since the accident. ask how the weekend went after. he's booked a cottage nr Bibury, dog-friendly so their spaniel Rolo can come. he's also got a necklace engraved w/ the wedding date. was worried it wouldn't arrive in time, came yesterday
